title: Jarum - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Jarum in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: The Continent - defeat the Chromatic Jar west of Old Lumiere

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Jarum is a physical-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Defense (B), Luck (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Jarum
sections.content:
Location: The Continent - defeat the Chromatic Jar west of Old Lumiere.

Obtained from The Continent - defeat the Chromatic Jar west of Old Lumiere.

sections.title: Is the Jarum Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (B), Luck (C). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
